title: Rust generic SCHC selection mislabels plaintext as OSCORE
description: Rust OSCORE and plaintext rule descriptors are identical and OSCORE Rules5/6 precede Rules0/1, so SchcContext::select_rule chooses a security-significant OSCORE ID for plaintext fields. The updated rule_versioning consumer already fails left=5/right=0. Require trusted parsed OSCORE evidence or exclude OSCORE rules from generic selection; update vectors/tests for both plaintext and genuine OSCORE.
